content.text:
The site looks like the approved screenshots again, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass. Two edits in `site/css/styles.css` were responsible:

1. **Navbar:** `.navbar` had `position: absolute`, which took it out of the page flow. On phones it shrank to about 240px wide and the header slid up underneath it. I changed it to `position: relative`, which is Bootstrap's standard value.
2. **Desktop heading:** the desktop (`min-width: 1200px`) rule for `.fs-3` set `font-size: 0.875rem`, so the "Full Width Pics" title was tiny. I changed it to `1.75rem`, which is Bootstrap's standard value.

I only changed those two values. I didn't commit anything. The untracked `.idea` and `.vscode` folders were already there.

STATUS: DONE

The site looks like the approved screenshots again, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass. Two edits in `site/css/styles.css` were responsible:

1. **Navbar:** `.navbar` had `position: absolute`, which took it out of the page flow. On phones it shrank to about 240px wide and the header slid up underneath it. I changed it to `position: relative`, which is Bootstrap's standard value.
2. **Desktop heading:** the desktop (`min-width: 1200px`) rule for `.fs-3` set `font-size: 0.875rem`, so the "Full Width Pics" title was tiny. I changed it to `1.75rem`, which is Bootstrap's standard value.

I only changed those two values. I didn't commit anything. The untracked `.idea` and `.vscode` folders were already there.
